events.did: Drew the gun from her coat pocket, thumbed the safety off and pushed the cracked-open door open with the muzzle
events.quote_anchor: June frowned, and drew the gun from her coat pocket, thumbing the safety off as she brought the muzzle to rest against the wood.

events.did: Walked into the suite with her finger on the trigger, expecting trouble
events.quote_anchor: June let the gun swing up as she walked in, finger on the trigger, expecting trouble

events.did: Saw right through Rios's shimmering body for an instant when the soldier glitched
events.quote_anchor: For an instant, June could see right through the soldier. And then she was back.

events.did: Fired once through Rios's skull while Rios's own shot hissed past her leg so off course it had to be intentional
events.quote_anchor: She fired once, the bullet tunneling through Rios’s skull. The soldier’s shot hissed past her leg a moment later, so off course that it had to be intentional.

events.did: Fired three shots into the first agent's visor and buried a blade in the gap of the second agent's armor
events.quote_anchor: Instead, she turned and fired three shots into the first one’s visor, the bullets ricocheting but the force knocking the first soldier back

events.did: Jumped off the balcony and watched the man she was wearing die on impact, shattering against the patio
events.quote_anchor: The man she was wearing died on impact, his form shattering against the patio.

events.did: Took a single shot fired from the balcony that tore through her side
events.quote_anchor: A single shot, fired from the balcony six floors above. It tore through her side, the pain white-hot

events.did: Changed into an old woman with blue-white hair and red glasses as she passed through the Iverly's revolving door
events.quote_anchor: As she passed through the Iverly’s revolving door, she changed again, trading the suave businessman for swollen knuckles and blue-white hair, red glasses heavy on her sunken cheeks.

relations.did: The EO whose voice on the phone came near panic, whom June had expected to be pacing
relations.quote_anchor: Given the EO’s voice on the phone, the urgency approaching panic, she’d expected Rios to be pacing, restlessly

relations.did: Helmeted agents who rushed June in the suite, one from the bedroom and one from the hall
relations.quote_anchor: They rushed toward her, one from the bedroom and one from the hall, their faces hidden by black helmets

relations.did: The first body June could reach after the balcony shot, inside which she hid to snuff out the pain
relations.quote_anchor: Panic flooded her mind, but her instincts took over, grabbing the first body she could reach.

relations.did: Strangers who called her Annie and gathered around a waiting bus
relations.quote_anchor: She was about to set off down the street, when a voice called out, “Annie, Annie, over here.

numbers.who: When June got to the hotel
numbers.quote_anchor: IT was after ten by the time June got to the hotel.

numbers.who: The floor of the Iverly that room 601 is on
numbers.quote_anchor: As the elevator rose to the sixth floor, she wondered what had changed for Rios.

numbers.who: How many shots June fired at Rios
numbers.quote_anchor: She fired once, the bullet tunneling through Rios’s skull.

numbers.who: How many shots June fired into the first agent's visor
numbers.quote_anchor: Instead, she turned and fired three shots into the first one’s visor

numbers.who: The height June fell to the patio
numbers.quote_anchor: Six stories was a long way to fall.

numbers.who: The bill June handed to the old woman
numbers.quote_anchor: Oh,” she said, looking from the handsome businessman to the twenty in his hand.
